set.body:
Bounded first benchmark implementation under PM3.1: one paired CSV admission -> geometry/velocity -> I-VT -> event-table export pipeline, over the frozen small/typical/large inputs and invalid-data policy. Choose the existing eyes4s public path and pinned pymovements path; reconcile output conventions before timing.

Acceptance: repeatable commands and raw machine-readable measurements for cold/warm wall time, throughput, peak RSS and available allocation/GC counters; output digests and semantic comparison; environment/input/config/source hashes; an intentional output mismatch and a failed process are rejected rather than timed as successful work. Record uncertainties and timeouts/OOM explicitly. Profile eyes4s hot paths and select a single bounded optimization candidate.

Reuse current consumer/performance tooling where it actually measures this pipeline. Do not install a new benchmark framework merely for ceremony. This slice supplies one baseline and does not satisfy the full workload matrix or PM3's improvement gate.
set.title: PM3.2 Record a paired CSV-to-I-VT baseline with complete outputs
